Chasing costs 16.4 runs in the SA20 — but that hides a wide spread

Across 103 matches at these grounds a first innings averages 154.6 and a chase 138.2, at 7.32 runs an over. On first-innings scoring that places the SA20 4th among the 10 T20 leagues we hold ground data for, against PSL at 172.4 and BPL at 139.2.

The league average is the least interesting number on this page. Chasing costs 40.4 runs at The Wanderers, Johannesburg and only 13.0 at Newlands, Cape Town. The highest-scoring ground on the list is The Wanderers, Johannesburg at 8.17 an over. A total that wins comfortably at one of these grounds loses at another.

The live model does not use these figures: once a ball is bowled it reads the actual over-by-over run and wicket pattern instead.

How the live prediction works

It starts when the match does. There is no pre-match tip here. Win probability is recalculated after every ball from the score, wickets in hand, balls and runs remaining, and how the pitch is behaving in this innings rather than on average.

Measured, not claimed. 81.5% win-probability accuracy on a true holdout: trained on 2017-2024 matches only, then scored on 2,546 matches from 2025-26 the model had never seen. Accuracy rises through an innings, from 79.2% at over 6 to 82.2% by over 15.

Next-over forecasts too. Expected runs for the coming over land inside the published range 72.3% of the time, measured across 46,718 over-boundary snapshots.
